thesis: Wide day-ahead spreads and nothing contracted, with a home fleet that doubles this year; Romania's own build is the main risk to the two-hour value. Two hours is the best design on merchant revenue alone; a fund enters only with a negotiated optimiser floor, whose terms are not yet priced here.
日前价差宽但没有任何合同化收入，且本国储能规模今年翻倍；罗马尼亚自身的建设是两小时价值的主要风险。仅按市场化收入测算，两小时是最佳设计；基金只有在谈定优化商保底后才进入，而该保底条款尚未在此定价。

reason: 2026-11-16: Graded on the investment model: the all-equity hold return of the recommended play, priced ready-to-build, ranked among the priced markets and graded by fifths. The return and rank are shown from the model on this page; the earlier dated rationale remains in history.
2026-11-16：按投资模型评级：以推荐方案按可开工阶段定价的全股权长持回报，在已定价市场中排序并按五分位评级。回报与排名由本页模型结果给出；原有日期的依据保留在历史中。

Fair evidence: a public floor-and-sharing precedent supports an investigation, but its price and full terms are undisclosed and no floor is secured for the target.

Check official grant status and target terms at the November checkpoint. At the January stop review, no identifiable project and executable grant/floor terms means submit Pass for this route.
11月复核时核查官方补贴状态和目标条款；1月截止复核时仍无明确项目及可执行补贴和保底条款，则提交该路线的放弃建议。

despite: A priced, enforceable floor could improve revenue stability; fees, sharing, performance and termination must be valued before any investment decision.
已定价且可执行的保底可能改善收入稳定性；投资决定前须计入费用、分成、履约和终止条件。

text: Two hours is the best design here on merchant revenue alone; the return shown prices no floor.

An optimiser has announced a five-year minimum revenue guarantee for a 127 MW battery, so a floor is a route a fund can buy into.
已有优化商为一个127MW电池宣布五年期最低收入保障，基金可以通过保底路径进入。

despite: The floor is a condition of entry, not part of the price: until its terms are in hand nothing is secured, Romania's own fleet doubles this year and compresses the spread, and frequency-reserve revenue is saturating.
保底是进入条件，而非定价的一部分：在取得其条款之前没有任何锁定收入，罗马尼亚自身储能规模今年翻倍并压缩价差，且频率备用收入正趋于饱和。
